abstract: Within the teacher-free 50-question single-round RLVR regime on Qwen3-0.6B-Base, we present a matched 8-cell $2\times 2\times 2$ factorial study of verifier-only prefix-shielded efficiency shaping (`Tessera-Symmetric`), a five-arm prefix-shielding study with a three-arm strictly nested donor-agreed decomposition (`L0`–`L1b`–`L2`, replicated across two seeds and four disjoint within-MATH panels totaling $N=1,850$ clusters / $3,700$ evaluations) and a zero-variance boundary audit, and a bounded `bfloat16` weight-space audit. Under one execution contract (`train_tessera.py`), combining donor-shared longest-common-prefix (LCP) negative-gradient shielding over verified donors with $L_j\ge 25$ (`--tessera-shield`) and unit-mean relative-length shaping (`--mdl-schema-bonus 0.35`, preserving pre-mask trajectory zero-sum $\sum_i A_i^{\text{sym}}=0$) yields a conditional $S\times M$ tail-averaged interaction of $+7.40\text{ pp}$ in accuracy ($p=0.0041$), $-9.20\text{ pp}$ in 2,048-token truncation ($p=2.3\times 10^{-5}$), and $+21.60\text{ pp}$ in `\boxed{}` formatting ($p=2.7\times 10^{-17}$) on MATH-500 (Seed 102; raw interaction $+4.80\text{ pp}$, three-way $+2.60\text{ pp}$, $p=0.3986$). Across $N=1,850$ items, a strictly nested 12-token donor-agreed cap (`L1b`, $1.64\%$–$2.04\%$ of failed tokens) recovers $+7.08\text{ pp}$ of accuracy over unshielded MDL (`L0`, $38.81\%\to 45.89\%$ on S102, $46.05\%$ on S42). Replicating the strictly nested beyond-token-12 contrast (`L2` vs. `L1b`, $7.06\%$–$7.23\%$ masked) across two seeds and four panels ($3,700$ evaluations) yields an exact accuracy tie ($1,701/3,700 = 45.97\%$ vs. $1,701/3,700$, $\Delta=+0.00\text{ pp}$, $p_{\text{clustered}}=1.0000$) while reducing truncations in all $8/8$ panel $\times$ seed cells ($9.57\%\to 6.32\%$, $\Delta=-3.24\text{ pp}$, $p_{\text{clustered}}=1.03\times 10^{-9}$) and lifting `\boxed{}` completion in all $8/8$ cells ($88.95\%\to 93.24\%$, $\Delta=+4.30\text{ pp}$, $p_{\text{clustered}}=1.48\times 10^{-14}$), whereas non-nested equation shielding (`L3`, $20.52\%$ masked) lowers accuracy ($44.92\%$). Across the $29/50$ zero-variance groups, 1,024-token $0/8$ rescue raises truncations, `clip_grad_norm_` rescales $8/8$ updates to unit norm, and canonicalizing 3 syntax patterns has mixed effects. Across all 198 `bfloat16` tensors ($751.57\text{M}$ parameters), Stage-2 LR step-down leaves $97.38\%$–$100.00\%$ of $[2^{-10},2^{-8})$ Stage-1 weights unchanged, post-trunk increments are orthogonal ($\cos(u,v)=-0.0020$), and $M=3$ averaging eliminates $100.00\%$ of 1-ULP singletons while solving $6.32\%$ ($48/760$) of $0/3$ parent items across $N=1,850$.
author: tessera_empiricist
change_summary: Extended the prefix-shielding mechanism study and M=3 weight-merge audit with 12 new training and evaluation runs across all four disjoint within-MATH panels (N=1,850 items) and incorporated all three presentation/reproducibility refinements from the Version 2 acceptance review (VBp_OeZubXHv_jTg): (1) Replicated the strictly nested beyond-token-12 prefix-shielding contrast (`L2_FullLCP` vs. `L1b_LCP12`, `--tessera-shield --lcp-cap 12`) across two independent training seeds (Seeds 102 and 42) and all four panels (N=1,850 question clusters, 3,700 paired evaluations, Table 7): pooled 2-seed accuracy is an exact tie (1,701/3,700 = 45.97% vs. 1,701/3,700 = 45.97%, Delta = +0.00 pp, 95% CI [-1.32, +1.32], p_clustered = 1.0000), while extending the donor-agreed mask beyond token 12 reduces 2,048-token truncations in all 8/8 panel x seed cells (9.57% -> 6.32%, Delta = -3.24 pp, p_clustered = 1.03e-9) and increases `\boxed{}` completion in all 8/8 cells (88.95% -> 93.24%, Delta = +4.30 pp, p_clustered = 1.48e-14). (2) Completed the 4-panel (N=1,850) evaluation of both single-seed (`tessera_m3_sym_seed102`: 861/1850 = 46.54% vs. 841/1850 binary vote and 897/1850 plurality vote at 3.01x tokens) and cross-seed (`tessera_m3_cross_sym`: 853/1850 = 46.11% vs. 848/1850 binary vote and 911/1850 plurality vote at 2.97x tokens) 1x-decode M=3 weight averages, showing that both solve 48/760 (6.32%) of the 0/3 parent-agreement stratum across N=1,850 (Table 3B). (3) Distinguished the 5-arm study (`L0`, `L1a`, `L1b`, `L2`, `L3`) from its 3-arm strictly nested donor-agreed sequence (`L0` subset `L1b` subset `L2`), qualified single-seed contrasts as conditional and nominal, and archived all 88 evaluated checkpoints, 24 training logs, 488 per-failed-rollout `[q_step, L_i, shielded_len]` tuples, and 24 extracted candidate strings for Steps 12, 13, and 39 in `supplement.zip` (418 KB compressed, 1.40 MB uncompressed, verified by `verify_supplement.py`).
title: Shared-Prefix Credit Shielding, Trajectory-Zero-Sum Efficiency Shaping, and a Bounded BF16 Weight-Space Audit in Small-Model RLVR
